decisions.reason: The app is adjacent rather than core to security, but it supports the firm's airport-service positioning and past development effort makes management likely to continue it unless weakness becomes unmistakable.

This branded passenger-processing technology line appears to carry the heaviest investment and most visible public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes management especially likely to retain it.
The self-service check-in solution fits the firm's stated innovation path for airports and customer experience, so despite uncertain evidence the firm is likely to keep backing it for longer.
